output.title: HTTP-01 challenge RBAC disablement already configured
output.content: This change adds support for the `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` helm value to disable HTTP-01 ACME challenges. The environment summary shows `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` is already set in the helm values. When upgrading to v1.18.0, this configured value will take effect, allowing cert-manager to drop pod-creation permissions if HTTP-01 challenges are not used.
